title: Try it: scaling plus a time shift

actions.source:
# Task: shrink a 1 Hz sine to 0.6 and shift it 0.2 s to the right
# The base environment is ready from the Seed's setup_exercise: t and x1 are available
# 1. Write the transformed signal x_task
# 2. Plot t against x1 and t against x_task, with a legend, title and axis labels
# Success criteria: two curves; the transformed amplitude is 0.6, shifted right by 0.2 s; the period is still one second

# x_task = ...
# plt.plot(...)
# plt.legend()
# plt.show()

clips.caption: Combine <c.aqua>scaling</c.aqua> with a <c.aqua>time shift</c.aqua>: shrink a 1 Hz sine to 0.6 and shift it 0.2 s to the right.

Draw the original and the transformed <c.aqua>signal</c.aqua> and mark both with a legend. Success criteria: <c.aqua>amplitude</c.aqua> 0.6, shifted right by 0.2 s, <c.aqua>period</c.aqua> still one second. Check, then continue.
